name: inv-9-one-rooted-report-parse
description: Engine code turns JUnit report bytes into testcases only through parseJunitTestcasesUnder in engine/src/core/report-run-root.ts, which reads every absolute testcase file against the root its runner ran in. Mocha's xunit reporter writes absolute file attributes; a shell that called the raw parseJunitTestcases would leave them unattributed, so a contract Wave reads no acceptance testcase and an owned Invariant's matrix test reads as not collected. This rule refuses a call of the raw parser anywhere else.
fixHint: Parse the report with parseJunitTestcasesUnder(bytes, runRoot) from engine/src/core/report-run-root.ts, passing the root the runner ran in: the repository's CanonicalRepositoryRoot, or the isolated worktree a mutation run used.
